Jill — great, thanks for the quick confirmation and for looping procurement. 12-week it is. Below is a concise week-by-week checkpoint plan for the 12-week close window (pulled from tab "12-week plan" in the attached MAP):

Week 1 (Nov 8 - Nov 14):
- Kickoff & stakeholder alignment (owner: Karthik)
- Access & provisioning requests submitted (owner: Raj)

Week 2-4 (Nov 15 - Dec 5):
- Integration work: API wiring, auth, sample data exchange (owner: Raj)
- Security questionnaire (self-serve) started by Sara; Redwood to provide SOC2 evidence pack (owner: Marissa)

Week 5-7 (Dec 6 - Dec 26):
- Pilot deployment in staging, performance tuning, and initial smoke tests (owner: Ben)
- Data processing and privacy checks (owner: Sara)

Week 8-10 (Dec 27 - Jan 16):
- Pilot validation with production-like traffic, SLA verification (owner: Raj/Ben)
- Interim findings review (owner: Karthik)

Week 11-12 (Jan 17 - Jan 30):
- Final validation, sign-off, and go/no-go decision (owners: Jill + HealthWave exec sponsor)
- Contract finalization and PO/invoice alignment (owner: procurement@healthwave.com)

Key dependencies: procurement PO issuance (typical net-30 or PO), security review turnaround (we'll supply SOC2 artifacts and a short evidence packet), and a single point of contact for infra requests (Raj recommended).

Quick answers to procurement questions:
- SOC2: yes — we'll share Redwood's SOC2 Type II summary and a downloadable evidence bundle (I'll send the link to Marissa for the pack).
- Pilot billing: we can do pilot invoicing on PO + 30 days net (flexible if you need milestone billing; we can tabulate in the MAP).

We can do the 30-min sync tomorrow (Fri 11/06) at 3:00pm PT if that works for Raj and Sara — I've tentatively added a calendar invite and put Marissa on the invite for the SOC2 handoff.
